reason: At base, single Y matches REGEX_FORMAT and falls through to UTC-offset fallback; expected literal Y, so test fails.
At head, REGEX_FORMAT only matches YYYY/YY, so lone Y and YYY pass through (or YY matched then Y remains), yielding literal Y and YY+Y.
Refactor only relocates tryDecodeURIComponent; percent-encoded params are still decoded at base.
Refactor preserves decoding behavior; percent-encoded params decoded at head.
At base reschedule() updates Redis via zincrby but does not set @score, so in-memory score remains stale.
PR adds @score = at.to_f after zincrby, so in-memory score matches the new time.
PR is about Range header parsing; Content-Type/charset handling is unchanged and works at base.
PR is about Range header parsing; Content-Type/charset handling is unchanged at head.
PR is about logging failed URLs; PHP ZipArchive::addFile preserves mtime by default, so test passes.
PR unrelated to archiving; PHP ZipArchive preserves mtime at head as well.
PR is about CredentialCache path matching; JSON deserialization of nullable parent is unaffected at base.
PR is about CredentialCache path matching; JSON deserialization of nullable parent is unaffected at head.
PR is about FETCH FIRST cursor; INET <<= ANY subnet comparison is unrelated and works at base.
PR is about FETCH FIRST cursor; INET >>= ANY subnet comparison is unrelated and works at head.
At base, NO_PROXY=::1 becomes pattern all://*::1, an invalid URL pattern; client construction fails.
At head, IPv6 NO_PROXY is detected and wrapped as all://[::1], a valid pattern; client constructs successfully.
At base, flags != IGNORECASE cause validation to raise ValueError when pat.flags check fails; DOTALL call raises.
At head, PR fixes flag handling so DOTALL compiles and matches as expected without raising.
At base, recursive parent tracking is broken for chain with group in the middle; result tree is incomplete.
PR updates prev_task/prev_res per task in the chain, so parent links are correctly preserved.
Test has -- in the middle (not first arg); PR fix is only about -- as first arg, so behavior is unchanged at base.
Test has -- in the middle; PR fix does not change this case, so test still passes at head.
At base, OSC11 response after VimEnter triggers OptionSet via nvim_set_option_value; ColorScheme also fires, so test passes.
At head, PR uses :noautocmd set background which suppresses both OptionSet and ColorScheme autocmds; neither fires.
PR only reorders internal checks around derive attribute; required-field validation logic is unchanged at base.
PR only reorders internal checks; required-field validation works at head as well.
